QuestInfo.name: Arin On My Mind
QuestInfo.1: Mars gave you Magician's Star Candy for Arin. Guess he's a pretty nice guy.\r\n#b(Go to Arin.)#k
QuestInfo.2: Arin is nowhere to be found.

0.0: That kid seems to hate Omens more than anything. She comes by constantly, asking me when we're going to get rid of them... And then I snapped... It's been bothering me all day.
0.1: I regret it. She's just a kid... Could you bring this to her?\r\n#i4033974#  #b#t4033974##k

yes.0: Kids like sweet things, right? Maybe this'll cheer her up.\r\n#b(Bring the Magician's Star Candy to Arin.)#k\r\n
#b(It seems to be a note. Judging by the terrible handwriting...)#k

item.0: Where did she go...? She would've loved the candy.\r\n#b(You need Mars's Magician's Star Candy to complete.)#k

lost.0: Hm? Did you eat the candy yourself? You monster.

yes.0: ...Shame on you for stealing a kid's treats.
